## About this little womblog

I'm a wombat, I like data. There's a mountain of places with mountains of data trying to make you feel and think a certain way. The only thing I can claim is different about this little corner of the internet is that it is a cave, not a mountain... oh and it's completely open source, you can see all of the calculations that went into the findings presented here. Please open an issue over on github if you have corrections to make! Let's be concrete together.

<3
